tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description:
Create a saved Maps campaign; public-source work may reserve/spend credits. All mode uses the wallet with null cap/budget. maximum_credit_units is in half-credit units (2 units = 1 credit).

        Contact choice: enrichment=true alone is Businesses + available emails (the default: every business i

tools.name: list_business_categories
tools.description: Browse or find pinned business categories; browse nodes are navigation, not selection.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.description: List the account's saved campaigns, newest first, as summaries; pass next_cursor to page.

tools.name: get_export
tools.description: Read one export's status, format, size and expiry; download_export returns its rows.

tools.name: download_export
tools.description: Return a ready CSV or JSON export's content, up to 1 MB; larger files and XLSX are in the dashboard.

tools.name: get_search_job
tools.description: Read the status and progress of one saved campaign owned by the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Read one page of saved campaign results; has_email filters without starting collection.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: Read one page of owned saved leads, optionally filtered by campaign and email presence.

tools.name: get_search_issues
tools.description: Read one page of stored campaign issues and attempts without retrying work.

tools.name: cancel_search
tools.description: Cancel an owned campaign, preserve collected leads and release its unused reservation.

tools.name: retry_search
tools.description: Retry eligible failed work in an owned campaign; may spend credits and access public sources.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Return credit balances and usage after applying scheduled paid-credit expiry. displayed_credits is the balance in credits, as the user sees it; credit_balance_units, reserved, settled and period_settled count half-credit units (2 units = 1 credit).

tools.name: enrich_businesses
tools.description: Queue website enrichment for an owned campaign or inline import; accepted emails may spend credits.

tools.name: export_results
tools.description: Create or reuse CSV/JSON/XLSX artifacts for a saved campaign/filter; may extend artifact expiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, list_leads, get_search_issues · Private data: search_businesses, download_export · Public sink: search_businesses, list_leads · Destructive: get_export.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, list_leads, get_search_issues · Private data: search_businesses, download_export · Public sink: search_businesses, list_leads · Destructive: get_export

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
